question: Should this proven Stop-recovery fix be refreshed onto current main by the contributor, adopted by maintainers, or paused in favor of another fix for the linked WebChat Stop bug?
rationale: The patch is useful and proof-backed, but the branch is conflicting and the remaining choice is how maintainers want to carry a session-state change across the current UI/Gateway refactor.

options.title: Ask for current-main refresh
options.body: Have the contributor rebase onto current main and move the UI changes into the current chat lifecycle surface before merge review.

options.title: Maintainer adopts the fix
options.body: A maintainer can transplant the proven logic into current main if the linked P1 bug needs faster handling than contributor refresh.

options.title: Pause for alternate fix
options.body: Leave this PR open only as reference if maintainers decide another current-main branch should own the session-state repair.

recommendation.title: Ask for current-main refresh
recommendation.body: Have the contributor rebase onto current main and move the UI changes into the current chat lifecycle surface before merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, already reviewed the session-state invariant, and are the clearest routing owner for whether to refresh or adopt the branch.
